data.name: ❄️ Snow Chase
data.description:
❄️ SNOW CHASE: the snowball tag game! ❄️

Throw snowballs, dodge and outplay everyone! Each round you vote for the MAP and the MODE, with 3 modes to choose from every time.

🎮 8 GAME MODES
Classic, Duel, Free For All, King of the Hill, Snow Royale, Teams, Elimination and Freeze Bomb!

❄️ 50+ SNOWBALLS
Penguins, yetis, dragon eggs, galaxy, gold and more, all in 3D!

🗺️ 9 MAPS: Snow Castle, Snowy Village, Frozen Maze, Pine Forest, Frost Clearing, Frozen Lakes, Hidden Valley, Ice Palace and Winter Park

📜 Daily quests and login rewards
⚡ DASH, SHOVE and power-ups
🏆 Global WINS leaderboard
👀 Joined mid-round? Watch the match and play the next one!

🎮 CONTROLS
PC: aim with the mouse and click to throw, E to dash
Mobile: tap THROW and DASH

🆕 LATEST UPDATE
+ 3 modes per vote, a new mix every round
+ Hits pop +1 and build combos
+ Collapsible side panels
+ New daily quests
+ Fixed respawning on the hill

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
Found a bug? Tell us in the group!
